# Welcome

## Matt McCabe

I'm a Data Scientist in the healthcare/biotechnology industry.

I analyze complex data to solve real clinical problems in medical imaging. My background spans laboratory neuroscience, therapeutic development, and computational modeling — all converging on my current work applying AI to radiology.

## What You'll Find Here

- **Data Science Explorations**: Analyses, tutorials, and insights on methods I'm using and learning
- **Applied AI in Healthcare**: Perspectives on bringing AI into healthcare/biomedical workflows
- **Technical Guides**: Practical implementations in Python, Bayesian methods, and machine learning
- **Occasional Detours**: Thoughts on life and other interests
